source_title: Did Gumroad Just Get Dumped By Paypal
snippet_primary: "We wanted to inform you that PayPal has suspended Gumroad's use of their service. As a result, we can no longer process payouts to PayPal accounts. We've invested heavily in direct bank transfers for nearly every country. We encourage you to connect a bank account directly to your Gumroad account to ensure uninterrupted payouts."
